name: zinterp_context_clear_macro_table
description: zInterp_Context::ClearMacroTable frees owned macro names and values, frees the table, and clears the macro table state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c1670 validates freeing each macroTable entry name and value, freeing the macro table when non-null, then clearing macroTable and macroCount.
The native smoke verifies populated and empty clear paths leave the macro table pointer null and count zero.
